faq_parent_1_a: SecuriClick generates a temporary QR code for each pickup. School staff scan it to approve your child leaving. Every pickup is logged and you are notified in real time.
faq_parent_2_q: How do I add an authorized collector?
faq_parent_2_a: Go to the Children tab, select your child, then tap “Add a collector”. Enter their details and a 6-digit sign-in code they will use to sign in.
faq_parent_3_q: Does the collector get access automatically?
faq_parent_3_a: Yes. An invitation email is sent to the address you enter. They can then sign in with their email and the PIN you give them.
faq_parent_4_q: How do I temporarily turn off a collector?
faq_parent_4_a: On the collector's page (Children > your child > collector), use the toggle at the top right to turn their access on or off instantly.
faq_parent_5_q: Is my QR code valid for long?
faq_parent_5_a: No. Each QR code can be used only once and expires after a short time for security reasons. A new code is generated each time.
faq_parent_6_q: What happens if a pickup is refused?
faq_parent_6_a: You get an immediate notification with the reason. The school blocked access because the collector or the QR code was not valid.
faq_parent_7_q: How do I edit my child's details?
faq_parent_7_a: Go to the Children tab, tap your child's profile, then tap the edit icon.
faq_parent_8_a: Send an email to contact@securi-click.com. We reply within 24 to 48 business hours.
faq_collector_1_q: How do I sign in as a collector?
faq_collector_1_a: Use the email and the 6-digit PIN the parent gave you. This code is confidential — do not share it.
faq_collector_2_q: What if I don't know my PIN?
faq_collector_2_a: Contact the parent who authorized you directly. They can generate a new code from their app.
faq_collector_3_q: How do I collect a child?
faq_collector_3_a: Show the QR code from the QR Code tab to the school staff. They will scan it to approve the pickup.
faq_collector_4_q: My QR code is refused — what should I do?
faq_collector_4_a: Your access may be turned off or the QR code may have expired. Ask the parent to turn your authorization back on or to generate a new code.
faq_collector_5_q: Why do I need to verify my identity?
faq_collector_5_a: Identity verification lets the school confirm that you are the person the parent authorized. It is optional but recommended to make pickups smoother.
faq_collector_6_q: How do I submit my ID document?
faq_collector_6_a: In your profile, tap “ID document” and follow the steps to take a photo of your document.
faq_collector_7_a: Yes. All data is encrypted and hosted in Europe. SecuriClick complies with the GDPR. Your information is never shared with third parties.
faq_collector_8_a: Send an email to contact@securi-click.com. We reply within 24 to 48 business hours.
faq_school_1_q: How do I scan a pickup QR code?
faq_school_1_a: Go to the Scanner tab, allow camera access, then point at the collector's QR code. Validation is automatic and instant.
faq_school_2_q: What if the scan fails or is refused?
faq_school_2_a: A clear message shows the reason for the refusal (expired QR code, collector turned off, child not enrolled…). Contact the parent if the problem persists.
faq_school_3_q: How do I see the pickup history?
faq_school_3_a: The History tab shows every pickup from today and previous days. Use the All / Validated / Refused filters to narrow it down.
faq_school_4_q: How do I access my school's details?
faq_school_4_a: All your school's details are shown in the Profile tab. Tap “Edit school” to update them.
faq_school_5_q: Are notifications sent in real time?
faq_school_5_a: Yes. Every validation, refusal or incident triggers an immediate notification. The bell above the scanner shows the number of unread ones.
faq_school_6_q: How do I manage the school logo?
faq_school_6_a: In the Profile tab, tap the logo to change it. You can take a photo or choose one from your library.
faq_school_7_q: Can several staff members use the app?
faq_school_7_a: For now, a single administrator account is linked to a school. If you need more access, contact support.
faq_school_8_a: Send an email to contact@securi-click.com. We reply within 24 to 48 business hours.
